quantize_mxfp8_tensor: quantize a torch tensor to MXFP8 e4m3 format with optional swizzled scale layout
dequant_mxfp8_to_bf16: dequantize an MXFP8 tensor back to bfloat16 using stored per-block scales
swizzle_mxfp8_scale: swizzle MXFP8 scales from row-major 2D layout to F8_128x4 transposed layout
build_mxfp8_quantize_custom_op: build a registered torch custom op for MXFP8 quantization with flashinfer fallback on Hopper GPUs
test_mxfp8_fake_quantize: test torch.compile tracing with fake MXFP8 quantize returning empty tensors of correct shapes
